title: Published text broken in Ruffle: empty editable textbox instead of authored static text
description: User report: text authored on stage shows at runtime (Ruffle) as an editable empty input box — no text content, and editable despite the author not making it an input field. Two failures in DefineEditText emission (packages/swf/src/text.ts): (1) content missing — HasText/InitialText not surviving (verify flag encoding post-0047 and that the string is written and the font reference resolves; 0093 added DefineFont2 — check FontID wiring and UseOutlines/device-font fallback); (2) editability — static text must publish as ReadOnly (and typically NoSelect); default text type in this app should map to Flash static text semantics. Note Flash 8 actually publishes static text as DefineText/DefineText2 with glyph indices, not DefineEditText — decide whether to fix DefineEditText flags (short term) or implement DefineText for static text (accurate). Add 0094 parse-back assertions (flags decoded: readOnly=1, hasText=1, initialText matches) plus a 0096 visual check. See docs/06-text-typography.md, docs/15.
